mapper.sql: SELECT c.comment_id, c.target_type, c.target_id, c.body, c.author_id, u.user_name AS author_name, u.role_code AS author_role, c.created_at, c.deleted_yn FROM comment_note c JOIN app_user u ON u.user_id = c.author_id
mapper.select: WHERE c.target_type = #{targetType} AND c.target_id = #{targetId} AND c.deleted_yn = 'N' ORDER BY c.comment_id
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO comment_note (target_type, target_id, body, author_id, created_at, deleted_yn) VALUES (#{targetType}, #{targetId}, #{body}, #{authorId}, #{createdAt}, 'N')
